The fix is commit `0e06523b799319ec65716df66eafb32aef170b3c`, "(fix) O3-6100: Prevent duplicate vitals saves (#3792)" by Dennis Kigen. It changes one line in `packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx`, line 225. The call to `createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics(` becomes `return createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics(`, so the submit handler returns the save promise. The form's `isSubmitting` state then stays true until the request finishes, and "Save and close" stays disabled, so a double-click can't fire a second save. The commit also adds two tests to `vitals-biometrics-form.test.tsx`: one double-clicks Save and close during a pending request and expects one call, and one retries a failed save without losing the entered temperature.

Evidence, best first:

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx:225` is the changed line, the `return` added to the save call. The promise chain continues at lines 225–250.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/vitals-biometrics-form.test.tsx:298-367` holds the new double-click and retry tests from the same commit.
- The commit `0e06523` is the answering change.
- PR #3792 is the pull request the commit message references.
- Ticket O3-6100 is the ticket the commit fixes.
